 --> OTT Releases This Week: New Movies and Shows on Netflix, Prime Video, JioHotstar and More
 From crime dramas and time-loop comedies to action-packed series and inspiring sports biopics, this week’s OTT releases offer plenty of options for your weekend watchlist. Here’s where and when to stream the latest films and shows across Netflix, Amazon Prime Video and JioHotstar. 
 Gayatri Rani 
 October 23, 2026 / 11:56 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 New movies and shows 
 This week brings a new, exciting selection of movies and shows to add to your weekend watchlist.
 From a group of friends whose pursuit of a better life takes a dangerous turn to a prisoner's struggle to clear his name, this week's releases cover crime, comedy and action.
 Here are the latest titles worth checking out.
 Chaar Yaar 
 This crime drama set in Mumbai during the early 2000s centres on four friends from modest backgrounds, portrayed by Purav Jha, Naman Jain, Saqib Ayub and Prayrak Mehta. Hoping to leave their financial hardships behind, the friends choose to take a risky path toward a better life.
 They are hunting down a handful of stolen luxury cars, but complications arise quite quickly. What begins as a scheme to earn money fast spirals into a perilous predicament involving gangsters and a determined police inspector.
 Chaar Yaar will premiere on October 23, 2026, on Amazon Prime Video.
 Also Read:  The Paradise OTT release: When and where to watch Nani starrer action drama online 
 Gajab Raat 
 Manoj Bajpayee portrays Ajay Dixit, a crooked Delhi police officer whose life changes unexpectedly when an injured woman is tossed out of a moving car. What starts out as an investigation soon pulls him into a murder conspiracy that involves powerful interests. As the stakes grow higher, Ajay has to choose between continuing to chase illegal profits and carrying out his moral duty.
 Gajab Raat is set to premiere on October 23 on Netflix.
 Lupin Part 4 
 Lupin Part Four: Omar Sy is back in the role of Assane Diop. Set four years after the events of Part 3, the story finds Assane behind bars and longing to relocate to Senegal to begin anew with his family.
 However, a fresh mystery emerges that could destroy those plans. A string of coordinated museum robberies in Paris thrusts Assane into the public eye when a mysterious thief sets him up for the crimes.
 Lupin Part 4 premieres on Netflix from October 23.
 The Legend of Hanuman Season 7 
 The battle for Lanka escalates as Ravan reveals his most fearsome form, driving the struggle toward a decisive confrontation. As the war's outcome hangs in the balance, Hanuman embarks on a quest that carries him through time, into the forgotten chapters of Lord Ram's past, and finally to the realm of death in pursuit of an ultimate weapon.
 The Legend of Hanuman Season 7 will start streaming on JioHotstar from October 23.
 Dhoomakethu 
 The Malayalam film Dhoomakethu will start streaming on Netflix on October 23, 2026. This time-loop comedy, directed by Sudhi Maddison, features Sajin Gopu, Nikhila Vimal and Shine Tom Chacko in the lead roles.
 By placing a time-loop concept within a comedy setting, the film offers a choice for viewers seeking something different from the usual crime thrillers and action dramas. Viewers can watch it in Malayalam, as well as in dubbed versions in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and Kannada, which extends its reach to a wider audience.
 The Malayalam time-loop comedy Dhoomakethu will be released on Netflix on October 23, 2026.
 The Paradise 
 The Paradise, a period action drama directed by Srikanth Odela, stars Nani and Raghav Juyal. The film, which is set in the 1980s, began streaming on Netflix on October 22, 2026.
 The digital release is also attracting interest since it is said to feature enhanced visual effects and a shorter cut. The OTT version is reportedly about 24 minutes shorter than the theatrical release. Viewers can stream the movie in Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Malayalam and Kannada.
 Sumo Didi 
 Sumo Didi, for all sports drama fans who enjoy real-life journeys, tells the story of Hetal Dave, also known as Shriyam Bhagnani. The film traces her journey toward becoming a professional sumo wrestler, a sport in which women have frequently had to challenge convention.
 Her story takes her from Kolkata to Japan as she strives to compete in the World Sumo Championship. On the way, she encounters social barriers, gender stereotypes and body shaming.
 The Hindi sports biographical film Sumo Didi premiered on October 23, 2026.
 Dorothy 
 Directed by Karthik Subbaraj, the Tamil crime drama Dorothy will make its debut on Netflix on October 23, 2026. Keerthy Suresh, Sananth and Rishikanth lead the cast of the film, which delves into friendship and transgender experiences in 1990s Madurai.
 The film also features a soundtrack composed by Ilaiyaraaja. Viewers can watch it in Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam and Hindi, which opens the story up to a broader audience.
 Karthik Subbaraj's Tamil film Dorothy releases on Netflix on October 23, 2026.
 Also Read:  Udta Teer Twitter Review: Ayushmann Khurrana, Sara Ali Khan's spy comedy gets mixed reaction; netizens praise its Dhurandhar 2-like climax 
 The Terminal List 2 
 The new season features Chris Pratt as James Reece, a former Navy SEAL, and is adapted from True Believer, Jack Carr's second novel. The plot centres on Reece, who embarks on a worldwide counter-terrorism operation for the CIA in return for a presidential pardon.
 The Terminal List Season 2 debuted on Prime Video on October 21, 2026, and all eight episodes are available for streaming.
 Gayatri Rani is a Senior-Sub Editor with over three years of experience in delivering Hollywood and Bollywood news.
